description: Header file defining the ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL class, which traverses shader code to translate shader storage buffer variables to HLSL code for DirectX shader compilation. It includes methods for outputting load/store calls, handling SSBO access, and managing shader storage block info.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL
classes.description: A class that traverses shader code to generate HLSL code for shader storage buffer operations.

methods.name: outputStoreFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Outputs the prefix for storing a value to a shader storage buffer.

methods.name: outputLoadFunctionCall
methods.description: Outputs the function call to load a value from a shader storage buffer.

methods.name: outputLengthFunctionCall
methods.description: Outputs the function call to get the length of an unsized array member in a shader storage buffer.

methods.name: outputAtomicMemoryFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Outputs atomic memory function calls for shader storage buffers.

methods.name: writeShaderStorageBlocksHeader
methods.description: Writes the header information for shader storage blocks.
